name: mod-settings-off
about: All 42 current feature modules and 3 required libraries loaded. Explicit per-feature applicability separates named effect/UI/unit checks, generated-floor logs, status-only checks and authored Classes PARKED policy. Adds bounded actual Affixes generator off/on, Attrclick trainer point-delta off/on with forced Shift, and Petrooms pet movement off/on on a checked trap-room route. Goldworth and library toggles are N/A. No exhaustive feature, persistence, ordinary-play, physical modifier/controller or co-op pass is claimed; provider off-start and delayed-sync cases remain separate tasks. Entries use explicit non-teleport Pilot intents and one bound pet ID with positive off displacement. No radius trap deletion; created IDs and unrelated-pressure preservation are recorded before disposable-floor abort. Owned initial settings reconcile/restore after failures without masking the original error. Petrooms pins the base Dog producer/type (idle 90px, leash 100px) and requires actual separation >=130px in every sample of both on windows, otherwise setup fails. No imported pet dependency.
